functions.name: send-failed-webhook-event
functions.description: Ask TheirStack to send one previously failed webhook event again to its configured receiving endpoint.

webhookEventId.description: Opaque decimal identifier of a failed event obtained from list-webhook-events.

FunctionInput_theirstack_sendfailedwebho.description: The previously failed webhook event to send again.

requestAccepted.description: The native retry request returned successfully; this is not proof of event delivery, per-event processing, or recipient acceptance.

FunctionOutput_theirstack_sendfailedwebh.description: Request-level acknowledgment of the webhook event retry, not a delivery result.

tags.instructions: First use `list-webhook-events` with status=FAILED and fix the receiver problem. Use `batch-send-failed-webhook-events` for several events. Retrying can cause another HTTP delivery and receiver-side effects; do not replay blindly after an uncertain result. The answer acknowledges the request, not successful delivery. Inspect history afterward.

functions.name: send-webhook-test-event
functions.description: Send one simulated event to a receiving URL or an existing webhook's stored endpoint to diagnose connectivity and payload handling. No webhook is created or reconfigured.

url.description: HTTP receiving URL for a direct test, or a test-only override of the stored URL. Does not persist configuration.

secret.description: Test-only HMAC-SHA256 signing secret, or null to request an unsigned test. Omit with webhookId to use its stored secret; omit without webhookId for no signing. Explicit-null override semantics require validation.

eventType.description: Simulated type for a direct URL test; required without webhookId and not accepted with webhookId, which uses its stored type.

webhookId.description: Existing webhook to test using stored event type, destination and signing configuration; omit for a direct URL test.

FunctionInput_theirstack_sendwebhooktest.description: Options for one direct URL test or one existing-webhook test with optional test-only overrides.

status.description: Provider-returned diagnostic status, preserved without assuming it is an HTTP response code until verified.

message.description: Provider diagnostic message as ordinary text; preserves null, empty text and absence.

signature.description: Provider-returned signature for this test, when present; preserves null and absence without reconstructing it.

FunctionOutput_theirstack_sendwebhooktes.description: Provider diagnostics for the simulated event, not confirmation of receiver business processing or future delivery.

tags.instructions: Use `list-webhook-event-types` to choose a simulated type. Supply either a URL and eventType, or webhookId from `list-webhooks` to use stored settings; URL and secret overrides affect only this test. This sends a real HTTP request that can trigger receiver-side actions. The result is diagnostic, not proof of future delivery, and replay sends another test.
